reader.requirement: At --std 85 the files a USE statement names explicitly, or covers through an open-mode phrase, may be of any mix of organization and access mode, and the one procedure must be selected for each of them (and count as the applicable procedure that excuses the 1985 mandatory exception phrase).

edition-consulted.switches: InForce (Year < 2002): the 85-only mandatory INVALID KEY/AT END, excused by a USE naming the file or a mode, whatever the file's organization (EXTEND only for a file that can be opened EXTEND)

reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf28_03 covers an explicit USE over indexed dynamic plus sequential and an INPUT USE serving sequential plus indexed random; not a relative file, nor a mode USE serving indexed plus relative

probes.expected: USE ON XR RL SQ (indexed random, relative dynamic, sequential) fires for each file's failure; USE ON I-O fires for indexed dynamic and relative random files; no exception phrase is demanded for any of them

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.8.3 SR5  (4.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5

reader.notes: DeclBindUse resolves each named file with no organization test (only an SD is refused, SR2 of the sort module), and the generated selector switches on the file key and the run-time open mode only. The 85-only mandatory-phrase screen treats a covering USE the same for every organization.
